C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION.Summary: Deterministic failure localization (D8): given expected V-M-* markers and an observed run log, report the first divergent block and the module that failed — or AbsenceValue with a reason — never a stack-trace stand-in for a question the evidence did not settle.
C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION.Problem:
When verification fails, a stack trace reports where execution blew up. The first divergent block reports where the flow started going wrong — frequently different. D8 restores that join: expected marker sequence from the verification entry, observed sequence from the run, first index at which they diverge.
At fe3aaa4 both sides of that join do not exist. Expected does: collectExactEvidence walks Marker children in document order into requiredLogMarkers (projections.ts:873-880, query/core.ts:189). Observed does not: health.ts:91-99 checks each marker with hasRuntimeMarkerEvidence (project-utils.ts:320-351), a static scan of source text for an emission statement — not a record of what a run emitted, in what order. No production path scrapes markers from command stdout, test output, or a log file into a sequence (A41.2 corr 93).
firstDivergentBlock(expected, observed) needs observed. Building the comparator without an input contract is the defect this re-derivation exists to prevent (A41.3).
Self-review is a localization source only for its mechanized subset (D8): scope, test-weakening, backward-compat. Phase 6 shipped those as family-B review.* codes plus hunk coverage, counterpart joins, and five family-A pattern detectors. Step 7.5.4's test was unwritable until those codes existed; A41.5 names which are admissible and which are not.
Flake classification already ships (classifyFlakeFromEvidence, grace-cursor.ts:1327-1367). D8 requires flaky results classified rather than pooled into localization signal. Phase 7 consumes the classifier; it does not rebuild it (A41.2 corr 98).
ngrace verification is find|show only (grace-verification.ts) — a read-only query surface. Localization belongs there as a query answer, not as a fourth issue catalog (D14, A41.2 corr 95).

Goals.Goal: Pure sequence tools: parseObservedMarkers(logText, alphabet) and firstDivergentBlock, with unit cases for each axis A40.2 forces — divergence at 0, mid, end, observed shorter, observed longer, repeated marker, identical, plus empty sides (A41.7 step 7.5.1, A42.6).

Observed sequence comes from a caller-supplied log: --log <file>, with stdin only through the explicit --log - (A42.1, answering A41.3 with route 2). The absence path is sharp: missing, unreadable, empty, or stack-trace-only logs produce AbsenceValue with verdict unable-to-determine, never a frame-derived divergence index (A41.2 corr 102, §7.7).

The scanned alphabet is every marker declared by any V-M-* entry in the project (index.verifications, query/core.ts:130,151). Markers belonging to the queried entry form the observed sequence; markers belonging to other entries are reported as foreign markers observed, in log order, and are never compared. A run that left the expected path must be distinguishable from a run that emitted nothing (A42.3).

The first divergent block resolves to a source location: parseMarkerBlockName (project-utils.ts:306-309) then the linked runtime file exposing that BLOCK_* name, reported as path:startLine-endLine from FileBlockRecord. Marker without a BLOCK_* suffix, or a block name no linked file exposes, is location-absent with a reason — never a fabricated place (A42.2).
Module join from failing test path via existing V-M-* testFiles and governed linkedModuleIds (A41.2 corr 97). Ungoverned path is absence, not a guess.
Reuse AbsenceValue / AbsenceVerdict (grace-cursor.ts:69-74). No second absence vocabulary (A41.2 corr 99, anti-pattern 5).

Review findings enter through --review-json <file>, reading the document ngrace review --format json already emits (schemaVersion 1.0.0, findings[]), so the admissibility filter has a real producer rather than a unit-tested private function (A42.5, D16). D8's admissible set is closed by name — review.scope-outside-write-scope, review.test-assertion-weakened, review.compat-new-error — and mechanization is necessary, not sufficient: every other catalog code is excluded, including family A and hunk-uncovered, and any addition is an amendment rather than an inference (A41.5 as governed by A42.4). None replaces the marker-sequence answer. With the flag absent, process context is simply absent and no AbsenceValue is owed.
Surface as ngrace verification localize (read-only query). Consume from ngrace-fix with minimal skill text; mirror byte-identical (D15, §12.2). Writes nothing (F1).

Constraints.Constraint: A41.3 is answered in A42.1: route (2), caller-supplied log. Route (1) is deferred with its cost recorded, not silently dropped (A12.4).

Every localization absence in v1 carries verdict unable-to-determine. not-run is unused: it means the toolkit knows execution was skipped (grace-cursor.ts:996), and with route (1) deferred this surface never runs anything (A42.1).
Every occurrence of a marker is kept, in log order. Collapsing repeats to first-occurrence makes the observed-longer axis unreachable from any real log (A42.6).
No new runtime dependencies. Surgical diffs only (§0.1).
src/lint/core.ts does not learn about localization. No localize.* catalog without an amendment that says so (D14, A41.2 corr 95).
ngrace verification localize does not author status, Verdicts, Decisions, or archive paths (F1, invariant 8).
Do not rebuild classifyFlakeFromEvidence or invent a parallel flake enum (A41.2 corr 98).
Do not present a stack trace as the divergence point under any path (§7.7.1, A41.2 corr 102).
Static health.required-log-marker-not-found remains the static check; localization does not replace or silence it (A41.2 corr 93 vs route 3).
Skill edits under skills/ngrace/ are mirrored to plugins/ngrace/skills/ngrace/ in the same commit (§12.2).

Standing rule 10 (A30.6): localization answers are query-scoped and ephemeral to the invocation unless a later decision records them. Do not invent a ledger section mid-phase without stating scope first.
A40.2: a control is only evidence about the axis it varies. Six comparator axes are six cases, not one.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Making static source-marker presence the localization answer (A41.3 route 3 rejected).

Running the declared V-M-* commands and scraping their output (A41.3 route 1). Deferred with its cost recorded at fe3aaa4: spawnShellCommand (assertions.ts:589-599) captures stdout/stderr for exit-code and budget evaluation only, so no marker scrape exists for either route (corr 96). The route therefore costs the shared scrape plus spawn wiring, an opt-in flag, PATH/runtime portability, and its own absence semantics, inside a binary whose posture since §5.2 is that it reads and does not run. parseObservedMarkers takes a string, so a later C-* can supply that string from spawn output without touching the comparator (A42.1).
Rebuilding flake classification, the attempt log, or the review surface.
Feeding family-A pattern findings or counterpart joins into localization as divergence points (A41.5, D8 judgment half).
Making lint depend on run state or emit localization / review.* / gate.* codes (D14).
Inventing a seventeenth track-level design decision (D1–D16 stand) (§12.5).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-OBSERVED-FROM-LOG: A42.1 / A41.2 corr 93. Observed markers come from --log <file>, or stdin through the explicit --log -. Discriminating negatives: with no log the command emits AbsenceValue (unable-to-determine) and does not invent an observed sequence from source text; an implicit TTY-sniffed stdin is not accepted, so "no log supplied" stays distinguishable from "empty log supplied".
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-FOREIGN-MARKERS: A42.3. The scanned alphabet is every marker declared by any V-M-* entry in the project, not only the queried entry's. Discriminating negatives: a log containing only another entry's markers reports those markers as foreign and an empty own-sequence, rather than being indistinguishable from a silent log; a log interleaving two entries' markers produces the same divergence answer as the same log with the foreign lines removed, so interleaving never manufactures divergence at index 0.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-BLOCK-LOCATION: A42.2 / D8. The divergent marker resolves to a source region: parseMarkerBlockName, then the linked runtime file whose parsed blocks expose that name, reported as path plus startLine-endLine from FileBlockRecord. Discriminating negatives: a marker with no BLOCK_* suffix yields divergence with the location absent and a reason; a block name no linked file exposes yields the same; a block name exposed by more than one file reports all of them rather than picking one. No location is ever derived from a stack frame (§7.7.1).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-COMPARATOR-AXES: A41.2 corr 102 / A40.2 / A42.6 / §7.5.1. firstDivergentBlock covers divergence at 0, mid, end, observed shorter, observed longer, repeated marker, and identical (null), each as its own unit case; empty expected and empty observed are covered. parseObservedMarkers carries its own cases: empty log, log with no declared markers, foreign-only log, interleaved log, repeated marker. Observed-longer must be reachable from a real log, which it is only because every occurrence is kept in log order — a unit call that hand-builds a longer array is evidence about the comparator, not about the parser.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-NO-STACK-AS-DIVERGENCE: §7.7.1 / A41.2 corr 102. A fixture whose log is only a stack trace (no expected markers) produces no divergence index and never labels a stack frame as the first divergent block.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-ABSENCE-VALUE: A41.2 corr 99 / D5 / A42.1. Marker-less V-M-*, missing log, unreadable log, empty log, log with no declared markers, and ungoverned test path each emit AbsenceValue with a reason, every one of them with verdict unable-to-determine. No second absence vocabulary; no not-run in v1. Empty-marker case is not a confident answer (§7.7.2).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-MODULE-JOIN: A41.2 corr 97. A failing test path listed on a V-M-* entry or linked to a module resolves to that module; a path in neither map is absence, not a guessed M-*.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-REVIEW-ADMISSIBILITY: A41.5 / D8 / A41.2 corr 101 / A42.4 / A42.5. Findings arrive through --review-json <file> in the shape ngrace review --format json emits, so the filter is exercised end to end and not only through a direct call to the assembler (D16). Table-driven over every code in REVIEW_CATALOG: only review.scope-outside-write-scope, review.test-assertion-weakened, and review.compat-new-error may appear as secondary process context; every other code — family A and hunk-uncovered included — is excluded, on the single rule that D8's set is closed by name and mechanization is necessary but not sufficient. None of the three substitutes for the marker-sequence answer, and none may produce a divergence index.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-FLAKE-CONSUME: A41.2 corr 98 / D8. classifyFlakeFromEvidence is imported, not reimplemented. flaky → no causal divergence claim for that fail; unable-to-determine → no flake claim; retry → localization still allowed when a log is present. One fixture per verdict.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-QUERY-SURFACE: A41.2 corr 95 / D14 / F1. ngrace verification localize is registered on the verification query surface, returns structured text/JSON, and writes nothing. No new issue catalog. runLint over a project with localization available still emits no localize.* / review.* / gate.* from this change.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LOCALIZE-FIX-SKILL: A41.2 corr 100 / D15. ngrace-fix consumes the command on a short path; packaged mirror is byte-identical; token/line delta reported in the phase report.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit tests for six comparator axes, absence paths, A41.5 review-code exclusion table, and flake verdict treatments; integration test for ngrace verification localize over a temp project with a synthetic log; stack-trace-only fixture produces no divergence index; root lint 0 errors with C-FAILURE-LOCALIZATION present; skill mirror byte-identical; no writes from the localize command.

Assumptions.Assumption: Answered, not assumed: A42.1 settles A41.3 as route (2), caller-supplied log, with route (1) deferred and its cost recorded; A42.4 settles the admissibility rule as closed by name, retiring the question of whether mechanizing the anti-pattern audit widened D8's subset; A42.5 settles the review-findings input as --review-json rather than nothing.

Markers keep the [Component][method][BLOCK_NAME] shape the explainer and verification skills teach, and runtime code keeps START_BLOCK_/END_BLOCK_ anchors, so parseMarkerBlockName and parseBlocks resolve a divergent marker to a region. Where they do not, A42.2's absence rows apply — the assumption degrades to absence rather than to a guess.
